display-hero.purpose: The landing page h1. Width 80, weight 800; 3.7rem, 2.7rem below 640px.

display-section.purpose: Landing section headings. 2.8rem, 2.4rem below 640px; the closing section steps up to 3rem (2.6rem below 640px).

display.purpose: The replay clock. Figure style: width 82, bold, tabular lining numerals.

headline.purpose: The risk percentage on an alert card; a stand-alone figure in a landing sentence.

wordmark-deva.purpose: The wordmark in Anek Devanagari 700, turmeric, beside the Latin name.

title.purpose: Panel headings, ring names, the Latin wordmark, the label of the primary button.

lead.purpose: Landing section sentences, 1.125rem; 1.25rem at line-height 1.5 when they carry inline figures.

figure.purpose: Counts, rupee amounts, times, speeds and bar values, 1rem to 1.25rem; 1.6em inline in a landing sentence.

body.purpose: Reasons, row labels, legend and stage labels, landing notes and sources. The 1rem reading floor.

label.purpose: Text inside the Synthetic data badge and the Police | Bank toggle.

rootFontSize.purpose: Dashboard. 16px at 1440 x 810. All sizes are rem, so the one-screen layout keeps its proportions on 720p and 1080p projectors.

rootFontSizeLanding.purpose: Landing page. Same scale with a higher floor and a lower ceiling, because it is also read on a phone.

shadows.name: tag-float
shadows.purpose: Ring tags floating over the stage.

shadows.name: stage-control
shadows.purpose: The large Start control on the idle stage.

shadows.name: stage-control-landing
shadows.purpose: The large play control on the landing page's closing section.

shadows.name: button-float
shadows.purpose: The primary pill button in the clearing.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: An alert card under the pointer; absent at rest.

gradients.name: stage-ground
gradients.purpose: The stage vignette; the only gradient in the system.

focus.name: focus-dark
focus.purpose: Focus ring on ink and oxblood.

focus.name: focus-stone
focus.purpose: Focus ring inside the stone rails, where turmeric is too faint.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The system easing for entrances and the idle Start control.

motion.name: alert-in
motion.value: 0.9s ease-out-expo; from opacity 0, translateY(-14px), warm-lit filter
motion.purpose: A new alert card lands lit, then settles.

motion.name: ring-tag
motion.purpose: Ring tag and stage labels appear after the formation closes.

motion.name: bar-grow
motion.purpose: Result bars grow from the left.

motion.name: formation-close
motion.value: 1.1s expo.out per layer, 0.14s stagger from the rim inwards
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: layers draw closed when the alert fires.

motion.name: money-travel
motion.value: 0.85s power2.inOut; receiver settles from 145% over 0.5s expo.out
motion.purpose: A turmeric dot travels its edge and the receiver swells.

motion.name: focus-dim
motion.value: 0.35s; other rings to 16% opacity, crowd to 25%
motion.purpose: Pointing at an alert or tag isolates its ring.

motion.name: section-snap
motion.value: scroll-snap-type: y proximity; sections snap-align center; scroll-behavior: smooth
motion.purpose: The landing page scrolls a section at a time.

motion.name: tunnel-depth
motion.value: 2.6 layers per section; depth eased 10% of the remaining distance per frame
motion.purpose: Scrolling moves inward through the formation.

motion.name: tunnel-arrival
motion.value: clearing radius closes 27% over the last section, smoothstep
motion.purpose: The formation tightens around the play control.

motion.name: tunnel-close
motion.value: 1.3s expo.out per layer, 0.13s stagger from the rim inwards (max 6 steps), 0.15s delay
motion.purpose: On load the tunnel's layers draw closed.

motion.name: tunnel-money
motion.value: one dot per path, about 4.5s per trip (0.22 cycles/s), opacity sin-faded at both ends

motion.name: copy-fade
motion.value: opacity 1 within 0.1 viewport of centre, 0 by 0.38
motion.purpose: Section copy is gone before it reaches a layer.

motion.name: cta-hover
motion.value: 0.2s; background to turmeric-hi, arrow translateX 0.25rem; press scale 0.95

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all durations 0.01ms; graph shows final state, no travel or turning; the landing tunnel holds one still formation with no money dots

breakpoints.name: screen-floor
breakpoints.purpose: Dashboard minimum size; it does not reflow below it and has no mobile layout.

breakpoints.name: landing-min
breakpoints.purpose: Narrowest width the landing page is built and checked at.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Landing: display sizes step up, Latin wordmark and full link label appear, tunnel growth ratio switches from 1.13 to 1.24.

formation.designSpace: 820 x 680, scaled uniformly to fit the stage
formation.sites: one large (r 218) left, two small (r 124) stacked right

marks.flow: shaft width by amount, arrowhead at the receiver

tunnel.renderer: canvas 2D, fixed behind the page, centred below the 3.5rem bar
tunnel.clearing: stage-deep at 60% opacity; radius max(0.46 x short side, min(0.36 x height below bar, 0.72 x width))
tunnel.arrivalClose: 0.27 of the clearing radius over the last section
tunnel.layer: turmeric at 90% opacity, round caps, gate 0.5 rad, gate turn 2.1 rad per layer
tunnel.stroke: max(3.4px, min(9, 2.6 x radius/clearing) x max(1, short side/520))
tunnel.accounts: 3 to 5 filled role-colour discs per layer, radius stroke x 2.4 x (0.8 to 1.3)
tunnel.moneyPath: stone at 40%, width max(1px, stroke x 0.45), to the nearest account on the layer inside, only within 0.75 rad

narrative.overview:
Chakravyuh draws each detected fraud ring as the battle formation the product is named for: the victim's money at the centre, one concentric gated layer per hop, cash-out on the rim. The ground is a deep sindoor-oxblood stage under near-black warm ink bars. On the dashboard the stage is framed left and right by pale stone rails and capped by two control bars; on the landing page it runs full bleed under one ink bar, and the formation itself is the backdrop the visitor travels into. Everything on the stage is flat and drawn at a stone-carving line weight; nothing glows.

The dashboard is built for a presenter and a room, not a desk: one viewport with no page scroll, and a root font size that scales with the viewport so the same proportions hold on a 720p or a 1080p projector. The landing page is read alone, on a laptop or a phone: it scrolls one section at a time and sets its copy in a dark clearing at the centre of the formation. On both, text is sparse and large; figures are heavy, condensed and tabular so they read from the back of a hall. Honesty about the data is part of the look: a Synthetic data badge sits permanently beside the wordmark, stretch features carry a P2 chip, and invented figures are labelled as samples or examples in the view that shows them.
keyCharacteristics: Three grounds with fixed jobs: ink for controls, oxblood for the graph, stone for reading.
One accent, turmeric, which means tainted money, the formation, live state, or the one primary action.
Roles differ by shape as well as colour; every mark on the dashboard stage is named in the legend.
Viewport-scaled rem sizing; the dashboard is a single screen with no page scroll, the landing page scrolls a section at a time.
Flat fills and solid lines; depth only as a soft shadow under things that float.

rules.name: The Turmeric Rule
rules.body: Turmeric means tainted money, the formation's layers, live state, or the one primary action. Money: the money dot, the cash square, rupee amounts and the share of money stopped, the taint bar, the ring around an account marked to freeze. Live state: the Play control, hover on a ring tag or the dashboard link, the current section dot, focus and selection. Primary action: the one filled button that opens or starts the replay. Its only standing uses outside that are the two permanent top-bar marks, the Devanagari wordmark and the Synthetic data badge. Counts and percentages that are not money stay in the text colour. It is never a decorative fill and never a role colour.

rules.name: The Stone Swap Rule
rules.body: Turmeric does not sit directly on stone. On the rails the emphasis colour and the focus ring are oxblood; turmeric appears there only inside an oxblood disc.

rules.name: The Shape And Colour Rule
rules.body: No role is told apart by colour alone. Member is hollow, the victim is a diamond, cash is a square, shared devices are a dashed line, and the legend names every one.

rules.name: The Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number is set in the figure style: width 82, weight 700 by default, tabular lining numerals, tracking -0.01em. Numbers never appear in the normal-width body style.

rules.name: The One Rem Floor Rule
rules.body: Anything meant to be read from the room is 1rem or larger. Only control labels (0.875rem) and the P2 chip (0.75rem) sit below it.

rules.name: The Rem Only Rule
rules.body: Type and layout sizes are in rem. The dashboard root is `clamp(13px, min(1.1111vw, 1.9753vh), 24px)`, which is 16px at 1440 x 810, so the whole screen scales as one piece. The landing page uses the same scale with a higher floor and a lower ceiling, `clamp(15px, min(1.1111vw, 1.9753vh), 22px)`, because it is also read on a phone.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Width 80 at weight 800 is for landing headlines only; width 82 at weight 700 is for numbers only. A headline is never set in the figure style and a number is never set in the display style.

rules.name: The Rails Read, The Stage Shows Rule
rules.body: On the dashboard, sentences and tables live on stone. The stage carries only the drawing, short labels, floating ring tags and the legend.

rules.name: The Clearing Rule
rules.body: Where there are no rails, sentences sit on the stage only inside a clearing: an oxblood-deep disc at 60% opacity that the formation is kept out of. Copy never lies across a layer; a section's copy is fully opaque within a tenth of a viewport of centre and gone by 38%, before it reaches the layers above and below.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the stage is lit from within: no bloom, no blur, no additive blending. Marks are flat fills, and emphasis comes from colour, size and the closing of the layers.

dos: Do size type and layout in rem so the viewport-scaled root carries the whole screen.
Do set every number in the figure style: width 82, bold, tabular lining numerals.
Do keep sentences on the stone rails on the dashboard, and inside the clearing where the stage has no rails.
Do give every new stage mark its own shape and a named entry in the legend.
Do end a money flow in an arrowhead at the receiver.
Do use oxblood for emphasis and focus on stone, and turmeric on ink and oxblood.
Do keep the Synthetic data badge on every page and a P2 chip beside every stretch feature.
Do label invented figures in the view that shows them: as samples directly under the heading on the dashboard, as "Example figures, not results." closing the section on the landing page.
Do keep the tunnel's layers at 3.4px or heavier on screen, at any viewport.
Do honour reduced motion by showing the final state.
donts: Don't add a turmeric use that is not tainted money, a formation layer, live state, or the one primary action; the wordmark and the Synthetic data badge are the only standing exceptions.
Don't place turmeric text or fills directly on stone.
Don't add glow, bloom, blur or additive blending to the stage.
Don't let the dashboard scroll; only a rail scrolls, inside itself.
Don't set copy on the stage across a formation layer; outside the dashboard's labels and tags, text on oxblood belongs in the clearing.
Don't box landing copy in cards or panels; the clearing is the only container.
Don't distinguish roles by colour alone.
Don't put a shadow between the grounds; shadows belong only under things that float.
Don't add a second accent colour or use a role colour outside account marks and the legend.
